title: Independent reading: 1 John 4:7–21
subtitle: Read theological definition and ethical inference together.
overview: This paragraph moves from God’s love to an appeal for mutual love, using definitions, manifestation claims, and conditional tests. Map the inferential links.
The repeated ἀγάπη vocabulary should be read with its grammatical relationships and surrounding claims, not merely as a word study topic.

items.grc: ἀγαπητοί, ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους, ὅτι ἡ ἀγάπη ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν.
items.en: Beloved, let us love one another, because love is from God.

items.grc: ἡμεῖς ἀγαπῶμεν, ὅτι αὐτὸς πρῶτος ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς.
items.en: We love, because he first loved us.
